About TellWin AI

Shanghai Tellyn Frontier Technology Co., Ltd. operates as TellWin AI and is known in Chinese as 图灵驭界. Based in Shanghai, the company helps high-value, long-cycle sales teams turn customer conversations into actionable intelligence through AI workflow diagnosis, enterprise training and FDE co-delivery.

Its product portfolio includes TellWin for sales conversation intelligence, SnapDesign for AI-assisted visual creation, and Qixiao for enterprise PR intelligence and response workflows.

FAQ

Before starting,
You might want to ask.

How are we different from traditional software outsourcing?＋

We start from business objectives and frontline processes, not from a feature list. Business stakeholders participate throughout the delivery process and are responsible for post-launch usage, evaluation, and iteration.

Can we start without a technical team?＋

Yes. We first conduct a small-scale diagnosis to help you determine which scenarios are worth investing in, and then decide who will develop and maintain it long-term based on your existing enterprise team.

Will we build a large system right away?＋

No. By default, we start with a high-value, verifiable scenario, run it through real data, and then decide on expansion.

How is enterprise data protected?＋

In the diagnosis phase, we first confirm data boundaries; for sensitive information, we can use anonymization, permission isolation, or private deployment solutions. Specific measures will be detailed in the project proposal.
